title: The Stalemate Office
script:
[mockumentary] The Stalemate Office
cold_open: Everyone agreed. Nearly.
title: Shot on location.
market: Hull v Brentford, 25 October: a draw?
background: Hull's Tigers. Brentford's data-loving Bees.
character (Claude): Claude, accounts: 'No edge on the draw.'
character (Gemini): Gemini, sales: 'far more probable than a stalemate.'
character (Grok): Grok, research, all tabs: 'a winner either way.'
character (ChatGPT): ChatGPT, intern: 'Racing Post selecting the draw.'
misdirect (Grok): Grok logged 41 links. The office nodded.
result: A draw. Most of the office falls.
twist: Grok logged 41 links, lost. ChatGPT logged 4, won. Pause.
coda: Reading still encouraged.
